split_rule: Second lexicographic task in each original eligible native grading stratum. Only task IDs, eligibility, and task/control hashes can enter registration. All four prior development tasks excluded. Never select by outcome. Distinct tasks, no claim of independent customers.
development_primary: Per state and form, rate of a single schema-valid immediate specified action among graded replies. Contrast background deletion minus target deletion; original anchors both. Keep other legal actions, missing replies, identical wires and common document evidence separate. These immediate actions are not complete official scores.
validation_primary: Official successes gained and lost vs existing writer, paired by task and form. Record comparisons to the single graded first pass separately. Report per-task outcomes, missing, official action checks, actual body exposure, and joint-success searches, business calls, turns, tokens and cost. Four tasks are developmental validation; do not promote a policy on statistical significance.
candidate_policy: After development and before any validation outcome, freeze one domain-neutral writer instruction appended identically to each of the five formats, with cited development evidence, hypothesis and falsifier. The writer receives public experience and verified binary outcome only; no case IDs, private scripts, grade actions, correct arguments or development notes in its instruction.
